metadata.title: axisforge3d-research-reproducibility
metadata.description: Research code, frozen protocols, models and per-object results of the AxisForge3D learned grasp-candidate ordering study (Phases V-VII and the Phase VII extension), packaged without DINOv3-derived data, without YCB per-object descriptors or geometry and without the manuscript. MANIFEST_INCLUDED.json and MANIFEST_EXCLUDED.json list every file with its SHA-256, licence and, for exclusions, the reason and the regeneration route.
metadata.notes: Third-party material keeps its own licence (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Simulation results only; no real-robot experiment.
